--- slide 2: October net sales total is 1.8% below September, but October is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 1.6%
Metric | October 2026 | September 2026 | Change | Change % | Note
Orders | 607 | 589 | +18 | +3.1% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 6.6%
Gross sales | $42,374.92 | $42,639.05 | -$264.13 | -0.6% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 2.8%
Refunds | $2,125.90 | $1,672.94 | +$452.96 | +27.1% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 31.5%
Net sales | $40,249.02 | $40,966.11 | -$717.09 | -1.8% | October partial: 2 days missing; per reported day up 1.6%
Average order value | $69.81 | $72.39 | -$2.58 | -3.6% | October partial: 2 days missing
Buyers per active day | 19.4 | 18.1 | +1.3 | +7.1% | October partial: 2 days missing
Source: the store's daily order records.
Change % is the change over September's figure, n/a when that was zero. Buyers per active day is the average of each day's distinct buyers, over days with orders. Average order value is gross sales divided by orders.
Per reported day divides a total by the days with orders plus the days with no orders, so months with different numbers of days with data can be compared.

--- slide 6: October refunds total is 27.1% above September, but October is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 31.5%
Net sales total was $40,249.02 in October, 1.8% below September ($40,966.11), but October is missing 2 days: per reported day, net sales are up 1.6% ($1,387.90 against $1,365.54).
Orders total was 607 in October, 3.1% above September (589), but October is missing 2 days: per reported day, orders are up 6.6% (20.93 against 19.63).
Average order value was $69.81 in October, down 3.6% from September ($72.39), and October is missing 2 days.
Refunds total was $2,125.90 in October, 27.1% above September ($1,672.94), but October is missing 2 days: per reported day, refunds are up 31.5% ($73.31 against $55.76).
The biggest move was Refunds, 27.1% above September in total, but October is missing 2 days: per reported day it is up 31.5%.
The best day was Oct 31 with net sales of $2,187.62.
2 days have no data (Oct 14, Oct 15), so the totals are understated.
Narrative written from the computed figures on the previous slides.
--- slide 7: Data health: October is missing 2 of 31 days
Count | October 2026 | September 2026
Days in the month | 31 | 30
Days with orders | 28 | 28
Days with no orders | 1 | 2
Days with no data | 2 | 0
Stored daily figures used | 168 | 168
First and last day with orders | Oct 1 to Oct 31 | Sep 1 to Sep 30
Days with no data in October: Oct 14, Oct 15.
Days with no data in September: none.
A month with days missing is understated, so its changes are marked partial.
Days with orders, days with no orders and days with no data add up to the days in the month.
A day with no orders is one where a data pull ran and found none. A day with no data is one no data pull covered.
